facts.fact: IGF inspector general Christophe Bitasimwa said, as reported on 2026-08-26, that the US$22 million identified for the IGF's 2026-2028 digitalisation plan (US$39 million in total) will be mobilised from the IGF's own dotations from the Congolese state, not from donors; no appropriation or spending is given.
